cs.t: Agave syrup is virtually pure fructose.  As a sugar alternative it's ... not that great.  The insulin response is fairly low, true, but the high fructose content carries its own risks.  https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/agave-nectar-is-even-wo... > Stevia would be a non-sugar-based sweetener, though it does have a distinctly different taste. I'd learned to drink coffee with milk/cream, no sugar.  With decent beans (Trader Joe's Bay Blend, e.g., nothing fancy) and a Moka pot that's more than sufficient.
cs.th: Type 2 Diabetes and cardiovascular disease attributable to sugar beverages
